tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find APIs, x402 pay-per-call endpoints (USDC on Base) and MCP servers by keyword. Returns endpoint, price, payment method, auth and docs for each result. Read-only.

tools.name: list_verified
tools.description: x402 pay-per-call endpoints whose live unpaid HTTP 402 quote equals the listed price, with latency and last check time. Cheapest first by default. Read-only; Lordevo checks without paying.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details of one listing by id (from search_services).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories in the directory with listing counts.

tools.name: compare_services
tools.description: Compare 2-4 listings side by side: listed price, last verified 402 quote, speed and uptime from our own checks (anything we have not measured says "not measured" with the reason), auth, transport and verified seller. Read-only.
